<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Armor of Fury](/Classes.aspx?ID=2)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 82

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your training and rage deepen your connection to your armor. Your proficiency ranks for light armor, medium armor, and unarmored defense increase to master.
